scene: The awakened astronomer drops a glowing brass key.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view. On the left, an alert astronomer in a purple coat holds an unrolled star chart. At centre, the elderly player in orange cardigan and blue cap points his cane at a glowing brass key lying on the ground. To the far right stands the copper dome with its heavy wooden door shut.
shown: a tiny glowing brass key resting on the stone ground at centre
an unrolled constellation map held by the surprised astronomer on the left
a heavy arched wooden door set into the copper dome on the far right
